### Release Notes

<details>
<summary>hugelgupf/p9 (github.com/hugelgupf/p9)</summary>

### [`v0.5.0`](https://redirect.github.com/hugelgupf/p9/releases/tag/v0.5.0)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/hugelgupf/p9/compare/v0.4.1...v0.5.0)

Four changes since v0.4.1.

**Build with Go 1.26.** The `go` directive moves from 1.21 to 1.26.0, so
consumers need Go 1.26 or newer. This was needed to fix the macOS unit
tests: current macOS dyld refuses a binary with no `LC_UUID`, and Go's
internal linker did not emit one until Go 1.24. `golang.org/x/tools` moves
to v0.52.0 with it, since v0.17.0 does not compile under Go 1.26.

**32-bit ARM on Windows is no longer built.** Go 1.26 dropped `windows/arm`.

**The integration tests no longer import `u-root/pkg/uroot`**, a package
u-root has deleted. They build their initramfs with
`github.com/u-root/mkuimage/uimage` and `vmtest/govmtest` instead. This also
unblocks downstream u-root: `go mod tidy` follows the tests of imported
packages, so the dangling import forced u-root to carry a phantom require
and a `replace`, and a `replace` makes `go install pkg@version` fail for
anything in that module.

**Fixes carried along:** setuid/setgid/sticky bits are preserved in mode
handling ([#​108](https://redirect.github.com/hugelgupf/p9/issues/108)), and a flock unlock bug is fixed ([#​109](https://redirect.github.com/hugelgupf/p9/issues/109)).

</details>
